signals.summary: About 2% of staff cut after integrating forwarding and fulfillment teams; at least the fourth round of layoffs.
15% workforce reduction aimed at cutting costs and returning to profitability; mostly North American research and development roles.
Earlier cost-cutting rounds included a 20% reduction in October 2023 and a 15% reduction in January 2024.
Company careers page states the team continues to grow while raising the bar for excellence and technology.
Revenue reached $3.3 billion in 2021 and the company became profitable for the first time.
